name: threat_feeds
description: Adds curated malware-domain blocklists to Pi-hole and keeps track of them, so they can be removed again cleanly. Pi-hole can already take blocklists by hand; what this adds is management — each feed is checked to be something Pi-hole can actually use before it is added, tagged as Nemesis's own, and removable in one action if something turns out to over-block. It only ever touches lists it added itself: blocklists you configured by hand are never modified or removed, even if one has the same address as a feed offered here. Off by default, and enabling it applies nothing on its own — blocking is always a deliberate action, because a blocklist can break a site somebody needs.
